resources.string: Use at least 12 characters for a new backup. Keep the password somewhere safe: it cannot be recovered. Import shows a preview before replacing your data.
Private copies stay on this device. Images are resized and location metadata is removed. Photos are for your own comparison, without diagnostic analysis.
No photos yet. Choose a photo to keep a private dated copy.

Selected photos: %1$d. Export them in date order as a self-contained HTML time-lapse with play, pause and frame controls. It contains private images. Review the selected photos here before choosing a destination. Nothing is sent automatically.
Remove this private copy and its caption? Original images and previously exported copies remain yours to delete separately.
Loading photo, or private copy unavailable
Enter only the intervals prescribed to you. Saving a schedule keeps previous schedule versions and actual tray changes. Trays never advance automatically.
For example: 1-5:7, 6-20:10. Cover every tray once, without gaps or overlaps.
Start a new phase only following your prescribed instructions. Existing records remain visible.
Prescribed days per tray or retainer
Earlier actual changes were not recorded by the MVP and are not invented.
%1$s · tray %2$d · %3$s to %4$s · prescribed interval in days: %5$d
Close the current phase and begin tray 1 of this new phase today? This records your explicit choice and preserves previous phase history.
Apply these prescribed intervals to the current schedule? Previous versions and completed tray history remain available.
Show calendar (date field and list always available)
Worn %1$d min · removed %2$d min · tracked %3$d min
Time zone: %1$s. For repeated DST times include a valid UTC offset, such as 02:30+01:00. Nonexistent local times are rejected.

Insert a forgotten IN or OUT interval inside a single recorded interval of the opposite state. Existing switches cannot overlap. This explicitly corrects your history; unknown earlier time is never counted.
Delete this record from the app? Previously exported copies are unaffected.
Only recorded time is counted. Daily targets use the goal effective on that treatment-zone date. Unknown time and partial days are labelled; no medical conclusions are inferred.
Worn %1$d min · removed %2$d min · covered %3$d min
Complete days meeting your recorded goal: %1$d

Counts consecutive fully tracked days ending yesterday against each historical goal. Today and partial days never earn a day; an unknown or partial day ends the count. A break is normal. Follow your prescribed instructions rather than a streak.
Worn %1$d min · removed %2$d min · covered %3$d min · prescribed goal %4$d min

Export all recorded daily totals as CSV, with treatment timezone, historical goal and coverage. The charts and daily text above preview these measurements. Your chosen document provider owns the exported copy. Nothing is sent automatically.

Optional Wear OS companion: the phone owns the records. Watch actions wait for acknowledgement; stale offline actions are rejected without rewriting history. Nearby communication uses Google Play services. No photos, notes or full history are sent. Wear support requires compatible Google services and matching phone/watch app signatures.
This interval contains untracked time. Totals exclude it.
Some time is explicitly untracked because a clock change or a break between phases was recorded. Reports exclude that time rather than inventing wear.
This replacement includes treatment phases: %1$d; notes: %2$d; appointments: %3$d; validated photos: %4$d. All existing records and private photo copies will be replaced.
Records are saved, but old private photos still need cleanup. Restart the app to retry cleanup, or use Delete data to remove everything. Dismiss message.
A camera app could not be opened. Choose an existing photo instead.
Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD between 1970 and today.
Use tray ranges followed by days, such as 1-5:7, 6-20:10. Every tray must be covered once.
Enter a phase name, 1 to 1000 trays or retainers, and 1 to 365 prescribed days.
Enter a title, valid date and unambiguous HH:mm time, 1 to 1440 duration minutes, and a reminder from 0 to 10080 minutes (or leave it blank).
Enter valid start/end dates and HH:mm times, with the end after the start and no later than now. Include a valid UTC offset for a repeated DST time.
Choose your current state to start this phase:
Appointment notification channel blocked in Android settings
Appointment reminders need notification permission and an available appointment channel. Check reminder status in Settings.
